name: Google Drive
description: Google Drive lets agents search files, list recent files, read file content and details, see who has access to a file, and create and copy files. Agents can read all the files that the user can open. They can create files and copy any file that they can read. Google's Drive server has no tool that changes, moves or deletes a file. This is Google's official Drive MCP server, which is in Developer Preview. Each user signs in to their own Google account through the browser and approves access on Google's consent page. OpenBot has its own Google sign-in app, so the user does not set up Google Cloud. A file from another person can contain instructions for the agent, so check what the agent does after it reads an untrusted file.

prompts.text: Find the marketing plan in my Google Drive and summarize it.
List the files that I used most recently in Google Drive.
Make a copy of the budget file in my Google Drive for next year.

apps.name: Google Drive
apps.description: File search, reading, and file creation, over Google's Drive MCP server with browser sign-in.
